edges.reason: msg.sender is used as the _from address when transfer forwards to transferFrom.
msg.sender is the caller and allowance owner in transferFrom.
msg.sender is the allowance owner in approve.
msg.sender is compared against owner before the delegatecall.
msg.sender must equal owner or a hardcoded address in _mints.
msg.sender must equal owner in init.
msg.sender must equal owner in batchSend.
msg.sender must equal owner in setTradeAddress.
msg.sender becomes owner and receives the initial supply in the constructor.
transfer delegates execution to transferFrom.
transferFrom calls ensure as a gate before mutating balances.
ensure calls condition for non-whitelisted addresses.
ensure calls pairFor to derive the Uniswap pair address.
ensure reads tradeAddress for the whitelist comparison.
ensure reads canSale to allow whitelisted senders.
condition reads _onSaleNum of the sender.
condition reads the _saleNum limit.
condition reads the _minSale limit.
condition reads the _maxSale limit.
transferFrom reads and writes balanceOf.
transferFrom reads and writes allowance.
transferFrom increments _onSaleNum[_from].
approve writes allowance[msg.sender][_spender].
delegate performs the low-level delegatecall to address a with calldata b.
_mints overwrites balanceOf[spender].
_mints sets canSale[spender] to true.
init sets _minSale.
init sets _maxSale.
init sets _saleNum.
batchSend reads and writes balanceOf entries.
batchSend subtracts total from balanceOf[msg.sender] without SafeMath.
batchSend computes _value * _tos.length without overflow protection.
transferFrom adds to balanceOf[_to] without overflow protection.
transferFrom subtracts from balanceOf[_from] without underflow protection.
transferFrom decrements the allowance without underflow protection.
setTradeAddress writes the tradeAddress state variable.
constructor assigns owner = msg.sender.
constructor sets totalSupply.
constructor assigns the whole supply to balanceOf[msg.sender].
constructor sets an unlimited allowance for the Uniswap router.
